_comment: Single source of truth for the site's Content Security Policy.
Wix sends no security headers and offers no way to add them: there is no
_headers file, no header configuration in the dashboard, nothing. So the
<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy"> tag in Layout.astro is the only
CSP production actually enforces, and these strings are what that tag
must contain. src/data/site.ts re-exports the same strings; tools/check-pages.mjs
asserts they match.
What meta cannot do: frame-ancestors is ignored in a meta tag, and there is
no X-Frame-Options either. src/middleware.ts also sets frame-ancestors,
X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy on the response in
case the Wix edge forwards them. If it strips them, the meta CSP remains.
C1 — Wix platform scripts: script-src is 'self' only, on purpose. Wix still
injects cookie-consent, analytics and tag-manager scripts after our <head>;
those stay blocked. We are not widening the policy with static.parastorage.com
or 'unsafe-inline', because that would run a consent banner and third-party
tags the marketing site has never shown. Measurement stays off until someone
explicitly chooses to allow those origins.
The Design Component runtime (new Function / 'unsafe-eval') is gone;
@wix/sdk is bundled by Astro instead of loaded from esm.sh. Inline style
attributes still need style-src 'unsafe-inline'.

policies.base: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
policies.locator: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https://basemaps.cartocdn.com https://a.basemaps.cartocdn.com https://b.basemaps.cartocdn.com https://c.basemaps.cartocdn.com https://d.basemaps.cartocdn.com; connect-src 'self' https://photon.komoot.io https://www.wixapis.com https://edge.wixapis.com; font-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
